verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for an ecommerce platform, but the evidence shows no way to run the store (products, orders, settings) through natural-language commands. The AI-powered search and chat and the llms.txt file both serve the developer documentation, not store operation, so they are adjacent features. REST/GraphQL APIs are developer building blocks, not a natural-language interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
